gloss: relay pitching; use of relief pitchers

definitions.gloss: relay pitching; using relief pitchers in succession
definitions.explanation: In baseball, the strategy of bringing in one pitcher after another over the course of a game rather than letting a single starter finish. Also used with する.

examples.japanese: {継|けい}{投|とう}で{逃|に}げ{切|き}る。
examples.english: To hold on to the win with relay pitching.

examples.japanese: {監督|かんとく}は{早|はや}めの{継|けい}{投|とう}を{決断|けつだん}した。
examples.english: The manager decided to go to the bullpen early.

examples.japanese: {三人|さんにん}の{投手|とうしゅ}の{継|けい}{投|とう}で{相手|あいて}{打線|だせん}を{抑|おさ}えた。
examples.english: They shut down the opposing lineup with a relay of three pitchers.

notes:
A baseball term. Frequently used as {継|けい}{投|とう}する ('to bring in relievers') and in the phrase {継|けい}{投|とう}{策|さく} ('bullpen strategy').

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {継|けい}{投|とう}する: to relay pitchers; to change pitchers
- {継|けい}{投|とう}{策|さく}: relief-pitching strategy
- {継|けい}{投|とう}が{当|あ}たる: the pitching change pays off

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {完投|かんとう}: complete game — one pitcher throwing the entire game, the opposite approach
